title: Thai Braised Cabbage with Spicy Napa Cabbage
description: A flavorful and spicy dish inspired by Thai cuisine. The pillowy texture of the cabbage is perfectly balanced with the festive flavors of the spices.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the Syrian braise and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the napa cabbage and festive cabbage and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the soy sauce, fish sauce, lime juice, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and braise for 10 minutes.
Check for doneness and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot garnished with additional lime wedges if desired.
This dish can be served as a side or main course.
It is a great option for a weeknight dinner or a special occasion.
